reason_codes.employment_concern: Substantive discussion about Indonesian employment hardships, job seeking, or labor conditions.
reason_codes.abroad_aspiration: Explicit personal intent or desire to work overseas from Indonesia.
reason_codes.abroad_discourse: Substantive discussion, advice, news, or policy concerning working abroad relevant to Indonesians.
reason_codes.issue_abroad_link: Direct causal connection between Indonesian domestic labor challenges and working abroad.
reason_codes.sports_entertainment_exclusion: Sports recruitment, athlete transfers, or entertainment casting.
reason_codes.promotional_spam_exclusion: Commercial promotional spam, commercial job board link dumps, or irrelevant marketing.
reason_codes.academic_household_exclusion: Academic assignments, school homework, or domestic chores unrelated to labor market.
reason_codes.foreign_unrelated_exclusion: Foreign labor news or migration with no relevance to Indonesia.
reason_codes.incidental_mention_exclusion: Keyword occurred in passing without substantive employment context.
reason_codes.insufficient_context_review: Tweet is truncated, missing conversational referent, or too ambiguous for deterministic classification.
reason_codes.sarcasm_codemix_review: High ambiguity caused by heavy code-mixing, dialect, or sarcasm requiring human review.
